title: Sharp eight-query temporal cut for the frozen P104 itinerary
head: dff116efc2c4ddd7236020ad8316db5c98aa693e
body:
## Result

This adds `research/p104-temporal-query-cut/`: a sharp temporal communication obstruction for the complete frozen P104 itinerary of PR1972/PR1991.

Even permitting arbitrary additional or replacement **common-frame linear role mixing at every one of the 4,059 cuts**, while retaining the original transports and private-storage lifetimes, the source-to-target transfer has rank at most **eight arrays**. The original dirty-restored `G/2` channel attains that rank. Therefore no zero-new-transport correction in this domain can complete it to the 104-port identity.

This does **not** exclude the separately proposed terminal `+208 H1` correction, new or retimed transports, new storage lifetimes, or non-common-chart native operations. It supplies no new supplier or kappa. The 96 missing array directions are **not** a 96-child native lower bound.

## Method and proof-critical step

The checker authenticates the exact source witness, reconstructs frames by literal binary XOR closure, and saturates each equal-frame class at every cut. Thus it includes all permitted additional scalar edges, not just the original ADD list or equal-rank registers. It includes all 72 dirty helpers and eight owned-private-copy lifetimes.

At cut 2429, after events 0–2428 and before the first D-helper transport:

- the forward source cone is all 104 X registers, 32 G helpers and eight Q queries;
- the backward target cone is all 104 Y registers, 32 D helpers and eight Q queries;
- their intersection is precisely Q0,…,Q7.

Deleting those eight wire crossings disconnects every X input from every final Y output, including possible later full-frame-helper routes. For a finite address space of dimension d, every admitted linear X→Y block therefore factors through eight d-dimensional query values and has rank at most 8d. Identity completion requires rank 104d. A query's rank-eight **frame** is not eight arrays: wire dimension and native child rank are kept separate.

The written argument covers arbitrary finite linear programs in this fixed-itinerary model; it does not generalize a finite coefficient search.

## Exact evidence

The reproducible certificate reports:

- 4,058 original events, all 4,059 cuts, 444 exact frame subspaces;
- 106,254,468 implicit directed common-frame edges with chronological multiplicity;
- both directional causal scans and a separate cut-deletion scan;
- all 280 arbitrary logical input columns, all 72 dirty helpers and sources restored by the attaining original word;
- an exact `G/2` principal minor on ports `[0,1,2,3,7,14,22,33]` with determinant **1/256**, proving rank-eight attainment;
- `R^t R = 26 I`, `G² = 26G`, and `(I-G/2)^(-1) = I-G/24`, showing the residual has rank 104;
- eleven semantic negative controls and one positive basis-invariance control.

The negative controls leave each query out of the separator in turn, introduce a prohibited cross-frame bypass, or remove initial dirty-query compensation / final query cleanup. The graph controls reopen genuine source-target paths; the scalar controls reject the arbitrary-input endpoint. Every mathematical field is regenerated and compared canonically with `RESULT.json`.

## Complete favorable budget and limitations

The unchanged local profile is `{1:1074,2:58,3:86,4:104,5:48,6:24,7:8,8:8}`, with mass **2368 = 2312 boundary coverage + COPY56**, 2,624 scalar additions and eight allocate/copy/discard lifetimes. The tested completion adds zero transports, copies or lifetimes, and generously treats additional scalar mixing, hosting, idle remainder and precision cost as free. It still fails the exact communication condition before a recursive moment comparison is meaningful.

No global owner assignment, native phase recompilation, all-size lifting, precision theorem, outer multiplication theorem or formal-kernel proof is claimed. Inherited PR1991 native identities are explicitly distinguished from the independently replayed logical/frame facts.

- Scientific base: `564148b82ae9df72163f22106f15e73efca8aff2`, priority revision **4**.
- Single independent selection seed: `5e89c7275a4bd70898735aea8ad1e35d`, complex-mechanisms, refined `p104-side-correction`; complete selection preserved in `SELECTION.json`.
- Rohan Arun, PR1972 head `fd82d172f46933fd253c2c6de4bd5eaff5429cfd`: the entire scalar/frame `G/2` channel and dirty cancellation. Witness SHA256 `0f541bef7f19fdeffd67157684e9f03d785f42c89973632f508fc1a0452b580e`.
- Chafik Boukhalfa, PR1991 head `6e222517e182e98499239bc9a4009f540e1c5520`: native realization and retained source distribution.
- Adam Gall, PR1940 head `a9b7dfe2809092a9a4c90784d12bb60061e995e8`: 32-chain schedule; Josie Elliston / PR1071: P104 fixture; Ali Romman / PR1125: fixed-term carrier bound; retain the PR968/717/446/595/620 lineage.

The contribution is the **whole-chronology sharp rank capacity under arbitrary added common-frame mixing**, not a new geometry, schedule, tight-frame identity, generic cut lemma or terminal correction. [Discussion2080](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2080) and discussion1167 comments [18931708](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1167#discussioncomment-18931708) / [18931718](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1167#discussioncomment-18931718) add 208 transports and are outside this theorem.

The submission checkpoint `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2` changed workflow guidance only; catalogue, selected record and scientific sources remained unchanged. Refreshed overlap covered 353 open PRs and 738 discussion/comment/reply records with complete pagination, supplemented by targeted live and local predecessor reads. Offline-cache warnings and coverage limits remain explicit; absence is not a novelty guarantee.

## Exercised validation

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -B scripts/research_baseline.py
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-temporal-query-cut
```

Observed: `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY`, `PASS_P104_TEMPORAL_QUERY_CUT`, and `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-temporal-query-cut outcome=negative-result`. The registered command uses CPython3.12 with `-I -O -B`; the final registered run took 19.05 seconds locally. The baseline is a source-binding check, not the selected cold replay. Hosted CI is not claimed.

## Open next questions

A successor should change the itinerary or the common-chart operation contract: exhibit and price a source-information route around this separator, then check native identities, restored frames, whole-call hosting and precision. The package explicitly leaves non-common-chart monomial-wrapped additions open; their logical operator must be proved, not inferred from equal frame ranks.
